channel.title: FORM Field Notes
channel.description: Notes on training and published photographs from the practice.

item.title: A good session does not need an encore.
item.description: Feeling good at the end is useful information. It is not automatically a reason to add more.

item.title: Repeat the week. Notice what changes.
item.description: A familiar structure gives you something useful to compare, without making every week identical.

item.title: The ordinary run counts.
item.description: Not every useful run gives you a story to tell. It can still belong in the bigger picture.

item.title: The group should make the work clearer.
item.description: A shared session works best when people understand the purpose, not when everyone copies the fastest runner.

item.title: From practice. · Photographs & films
item.description: A few moments from the track and the road. An earlier selection, collected across sessions.
